Receives one chunk of a large file upload via multipart form data and either creates a new remote file (chunkIndex=0) or appends to the existing file (chunkIndex&gt;0). Used by the client to upload files larger than ~2GB that would otherwise hit browser-side ArrayBuffer limits.
